# Cronk Advisory

> Cronk Advisory Ltd is a UK technology leadership and architecture consultancy, founded by Oliver Cronk, that helps business and sustainability leaders align technology with sustainability goals: balancing business performance, efficiency and holistic sustainability across people, planet and profitability.

Cronk Advisory Limited is registered in England and Wales (company number 17112535), is based in Newbury, Berkshire, and works across the UK and internationally. It is independent: it has no product to sell and no preferred vendor.

Contact: hello@cronkadvisory.com

## Services

- [Fractional CTO and Chief Architect](https://cronkadvisory.com/#fractional-cto): Part-time CTO or Chief Architect-level engagement covering technology strategy tied to business outcomes, independent architecture oversight, board-ready communication and mentoring for technical teams. Typically from two days per month; longer-term retainers available; each engagement scoped individually.
- [Technology Advisory and Architecture Review](https://cronkadvisory.com/#advisory): An independent assessment of a technology estate, where it needs to go and a realistic path between the two. Useful before major investment decisions (particularly AI investment), platform changes, or to stress-test an existing plan.
- [Sustainable Technology and Responsible AI](https://cronkadvisory.com/#sustainability): Helping organisations understand, honestly account for and act on the environmental and social footprint of their technology, drawing on the Green Web Foundation's open-source Digital Impacts Schema and Taxonomy (DIST).

## Approach

- [Pragmatic Ecosystems](https://cronkadvisory.com/#approach): Cronk Advisory's methodology for treating technology and business architecture as interconnected human, organisational and natural systems, drawing on systems thinking, complexity science and sustainability frameworks, to find changes that work for people, planet and profitability.

## About

- [Oliver Cronk](https://cronkadvisory.com/#about): Founder. Over 25 years as a practitioner and technology leader across energy, financial services, central and regional government, and professional services. Previously Technology Director at Scott Logic, Chief Architect / Deputy CTO at Deloitte Risk Advisory UK, and Chief Architect at Tanium. Created the Architect Tomorrow community (2019), contributes to the Digital Impacts Schema and Taxonomy (DIST), previously co-developed the Tech Carbon Standard, and is UK co-lead of the Chief Architect Network.

## Optional

- [Digital Impacts Schema and Taxonomy (DIST)](https://dist.greenweb.org): Open-source guidance from the Green Web Foundation for categorising, structuring and reporting digital technology sustainability data. Oliver Cronk contributes to it.
- [Architect Tomorrow](https://youtube.com/ArchitectTomorrow): Community and YouTube channel on architecture, emerging technology and sustainability.
